name: jQuery UI Touch Punch
description: Provides jQuery UI Touch Punch library.
project_description: Provides the jQuery UI Touch Punch shim library so jQuery UI mouse-based widgets (draggable, droppable, sortable, slider, resizable, selectable) respond to touch events on mobile/tablet devices. Drupal core deprecated and removed the bundled jQuery UI libraries (change record https://www.drupal.org/node/3067969); this module declares the touch-punch library on top of the jquery_ui base module for any theme or module that still uses jQuery UI interactions. Beyond the jquery_ui base module it requires the external politsin/jquery-ui-touch-punch package, whose minified JS is served from /libraries/jquery-ui-touch-punch/. The module ships only a hook_help() implementation — no routes, permissions, config, services, or entities. jQuery UI is End-of-Life; the project recommends selecting a modern replacement rather than depending on jQuery UI in new code. Maintained by Morpht.
